Lesson 045: asset pipeline architecture

    What this shows

    Defaults do most of the work

    A good preset makes the right thing happen without anyone deciding. It can't stop someone who changes it by hand.

    Catch it where it's made

    The same mistake costs 5 minutes on the artist's machine, an hour in CI and half a day once QA finds it. Late checks still beat no checks.

    Import time is a team cost

    Every fresh checkout and branch switch pays the import. A shared cache pays it once for everyone.

    This lab is a simulation, not a measurement. It uses Lesson 045's numbers: 40 new assets a week; 6 oversized textures (+16 MB each in the build), 2 heavy meshes (+2 MB each) and 1 wrong scale; fixing costs 5 min at import, 1 h in CI and 4 h after QA finds it; a full import takes 95 min, 12 min from a warm shared cache. Real teams see different rates; measure yours.
